files.title: File:I-10 Twin Span out of New Orleans 28 August 2021 - 01.jpg
files.author: Infrogmation of New Orleans
files.caption: I-10 Twin Span out of New Orleans 28 August 2021 - over the finger of Lake Pontchartrain between New Orleans and Slidell, Louisiana - Hurricane Ida evacuation.  Occasional snapshots as East bound traffic frequently came to complete stops.
